integrity: All-field proof rests on trace decomposition and standard Gauss–Jacobi identities; finite enumerations are corroborating examples, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the norm–trace product on quadratic extensions; cubic nonuniform fibers retain an explicit finite character sum. Earlier equivalent literature may exist. No independent verification has been conducted.
title: Exact fibers of the quadratic-extension norm–trace product
